Bioinformatics (2007) 23(18): 2485-2487. The code was derived by Ian Holmes and Gerton Lunter from Holmes I, Rubin GM. An expectation maximization algorithm for training hidden substitution models.  J Mol Biol. 2002 Apr 12;317(5):753-64.  You may use at will, subject to the license, but *please cite those two papers* in your academic publications associated with uses of this library.
